TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.LNS_EODACCTBAL_DELTA;

WITH SRC AS	
(	SELECT 
	HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(ACID,BANK_ID,TRAN_DATE_BAL,TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN,VALUE_DATE_BAL,VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN,END_EOD_DATE,LCHG_USER_ID,LCHG_TIME,RCRE_USER_ID,RCRE_TIME,TS_CNT,EAB_CRNCY_CODE,EOD_DATE))
	AS HASHROW,
	ACID
	,BANK_ID, EOD_DATE, END_EOD_DATE
FROM (	SELECT [ACID]
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[EOD_DATE]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as EOD_DATE
,convert(numeric(22,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TRAN_DATE_BAL],' ',''),''),0)) as TRAN_DATE_BAL
,convert(numeric(22,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN],' ',''),''),0)) as TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN
,convert(numeric(22,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([VALUE_DATE_BAL],' ',''),''),0)) as VALUE_DATE_BAL
,convert(numeric(22,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN],' ',''),''),0)) as VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[END_EOD_DATE]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as END_EOD_DATE
,[LCHG_USER_ID]
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(LCHG_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as LCHG_TIME
,[RCRE_USER_ID]
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(RCRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as RCRE_TIME
,convert(numeric(22,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TS_CNT],' ',''),''),0)) as TS_CNT
,[EAB_CRNCY_CODE]
,[BANK_ID]
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM [D360].[STG_LNS_EODACCTBAL]
 where H = 'D'
) A ), TGT AS	
(	SELECT 
	HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(ACID,BANK_ID,TRAN_DATE_BAL,TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN,VALUE_DATE_BAL,VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN,END_EOD_DATE,LCHG_USER_ID,LCHG_TIME,RCRE_USER_ID,RCRE_TIME,TS_CNT,EAB_CRNCY_CODE,EOD_DATE))
	AS HASHROW,
	ACID
	,BANK_ID, EOD_DATE
FROM	BUSC.LNS_EODACCTBAL
WHERE	isLatest = 1
)	
INSERT INTO BUSC.LNS_EODACCTBAL_DELTA (SRC_HR,TGT_HR,ACID,BANK_ID,EOD_DATE,END_EOD_DATE,isActive,isLatest,RECORD_STATUS)
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.ACID,TGT.ACID) AS ACID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BANK_ID,TGT.BANK_ID) AS BANK_ID
	,ISNULL(SRC.EOD_DATE,TGT.EOD_DATE) AS EOD_DATE
    ,SRC.END_EOD_DATE
	,CASE WHEN SRC.ACID IS NULL AND SRC.BANK_ID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isActive
	,CASE WHEN SRC.ACID IS NULL AND SRC.BANK_ID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isLatest
	,CASE
	    WHEN TGT.ACID IS NULL AND TGT.BANK_ID IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
	ELSE 'UPDATE' END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN	TGT
ON	SRC.ACID = TGT.ACID
AND	SRC.BANK_ID = TGT.BANK_ID
AND	SRC.EOD_DATE = TGT.EOD_DATE
	
WHERE	(
TGT.ACID IS NULL
OR	TGT.BANK_ID IS NULL
	)
OR	SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW;

UPDATE TGT
SET END_EOD_DATE = ''
FROM BUSC.LNS_EODACCTBAL TGT
WHERE END_EOD_DATE = '20991231';

UPDATE TGT
SET END_EOD_DATE = DELTA.END_EOD_DATE
FROM BUSC.LNS_EODACCTBAL TGT
JOIN BUSC.LNS_EODACCTBAL_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.ACID = TGT.ACID
AND DELTA.BANK_ID = TGT.BANK_ID
AND DELTA.EOD_DATE = TGT.EOD_DATE
WHERE TGT.END_EOD_DATE = '';
